projects.sectionSubtitle: A selection of real-world work, from design to production.

unikin.title: LMD & Academic Deliberations Platform — UNIKIN
unikin.shortDescription: A complete university digital ecosystem automating academic deliberations, tracking results, and verifying digital coupons via QR Code for secure access to results.

modal.overview: A certified university information system that digitizes the entire academic deliberation cycle, secures results with QR Codes, and monitors consultation flows in real time.

features.title: Student Portal
features.description: Secure authentication via ID and temporary token for individual result consultation.

features.title: Deliberation Engine
features.description: Automatic calculation of averages, earned credits and success rates with analytical dashboards.

features.title: QR Code Security
features.description: Instant authentication of printed or digital transcripts via the QR Code Engine.

features.title: Monitoring & Logs Module
features.description: Live monitoring of connections, threat detection and server access auditing.

features.title: Department Management
features.description: Targeted access control to open or block result consultation by cohort.

features.title: Certificate Issuance
features.description: Generation of admission badges, downloadable as PDF or shareable via WhatsApp.

kinalert.title: KIN ALERT — Civic Safety Platform
kinalert.shortDescription: A real-time citizen alert and reporting platform built for the city of Kinshasa, including an intuitive mobile app and a centralized admin panel for emergency management.

modal.overview: KIN ALERT is a civic public-safety SaaS platform designed for the city of Kinshasa (DRC). It connects the urban population with moderators and decision-makers through a reactive event-driven architecture.

features.title: Local Emergency Resolution
features.description: Geolocated reporting of critical incidents (floods, crime, erosion, outages, major traffic) with interactive mapping.

features.title: Community Anti-Spam Validation
features.description: Participative confirmation algorithm preventing false reports via an adjustable threshold.

features.title: Industrial Architecture
features.description: Strict separation between Backend (Laravel 11 REST API / Event Bus) and Frontend (Next.js & React Native).

features.title: Executive Dashboard & Monitoring
features.description: Real-time KPIs, risk mapping and a Push/Broadcast communication center.

roles.scope: Incident creation, GPS geolocation, confirming third-party incidents, push notifications.
Moderating the incident feed, activity tracking, basic user management.
Global rights, confirmation threshold configuration, manager management, audit logs.

kimia.title: KIM.IA — Healthcare Platform & Pharmacy ERP
kimia.shortDescription: A custom web application for the comprehensive management of pharmacy chains, built in partnership with a German tech company.

modal.overview: KIM.IA is an enterprise health information system designed for the global management of pharmacy networks, developed in partnership with a German technology company and meeting the strict regulatory requirements of the pharmaceutical sector.

features.title: Anti-Expiry Blocking
features.description: Predictive analysis engine instantly blocking checkout for any expired or recalled batch.

features.title: FEFO Method
features.description: First-Expired-First-Out stock management combined with a continuous audit worker (daily Laravel Cron).

features.title: Database-Level POS Restriction
features.description: The BLOCKED_EXPIRED status is verified directly at the database level before any checkout.

features.title: Network Administration
features.description: Global oversight of pharmacy licenses and nationwide flow mapping.

features.title: Reports & Anomalies
features.description: Detailed reports on blocked or unsellable products, exportable for auditing.

roles.scope: Global oversight, license management, global audit and system logs.
Stock management, order validation, price adjustments, financial reports.
Sales recording, invoicing, access blocked on expired batches.
Viewing restocking requests, submitting updated product catalogs.

jolka.title: Jolka Beauty Collection
jolka.shortDescription: An elegant e-commerce platform for a luxury perfume brand, offering a direct WhatsApp-connected ordering tunnel alongside a complete admin portal.

modal.overview: Jolka Beauty Collection is a custom e-commerce platform designed to showcase luxury, oriental-inspired fragrances. It pairs a refined digital showcase with an innovative ordering system redirected straight to WhatsApp.

features.title: Luxury Immersive Showcase
features.description: An elegant dark interface with gold accents, highlighting every fragrance creation.

features.title: Dynamic Catalog
features.description: Detailed product sheets with scent notes (Top, Heart, Base), volumes, prices and live stock.

features.title: WhatsApp Order Tunnel
features.description: A pre-filled reservation form generating a structured message to customer service.

features.title: Complete Back-Office
features.description: Analytics dashboard, catalog management and detailed order tracking.
